cases.name: eof-sequence-then-reset
cases.note: form, then a single LF, then EOF. LISTEN leaves LF as lookahead. Calls: 1 reads lookahead LF ->0; 2 hits EOF ->0 and sets AT_EOF; RESET clears status; 3 getc at EOF -> 0 again (no error); 4 -> error

cases.name: eof-routine-proper
cases.note: third call has an EOF routine argument (4th arg)

cases.name: boot-quit-then-eof
cases.note: quit then EOF: YES/NO RESETs (clearing EOF), READSTRING returns 0, INBUF still holds 'quit'

cases.name: boot-quit-y-no-mdl-dir
cases.note: quit/y with MDL/ directory removed is not possible here (SAVE would fail); instead check exit and log only
